item.title: Nobel economics prize awarded to two Americans
item.description: American-born economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the Nobel Prize in economics for models that help governments and central banks.

item.title: One killed in new strike on Riyadh airport after deadly attack killed 13
item.description: The strike on King Khalid International Airport was the deadliest on Saudi soil in over a decade, marking a major escalation in the Yemen war.

item.title: 70 marathon runners evacuated after being stranded by heavy rain
item.description: About 70 runners and volunteers in Utah's Moab 240 ultramarathon were stranded overnight after a significant storm.

item.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after lung lesion found, Vatican says
item.description: The American pope has no previously known health problems and is known to be physically active.
